request.name: Create async request for an analytics report using a template

description.content:
This takes a template ID and an optional custom timeframe and constructs an asynchronous report based on the
template. It returns a token that you can use to download the report when it is ready.

query.description: Metric report start date (UTC). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be more than 2.5 years back from today.
Metric report end date (UTC). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be more than 2.5 years past start date.

TOTAL - metrics are aggregated over the specified date range.
DAY - metrics are broken down daily.
HOUR - metrics are broken down hourly.
WEEKLY - metrics are broken down weekly.
MONTHLY - metrics are broken down monthly
